issues.description: Solution for Aufgabe 07 omits the join condition between Gemeinde and Schwimmbad (it only filters Schwimmbad.art='Freibad'). The problem asks for the names of the Gemeinden that have a Freibad and the names of the respective Freibäder — this implies a relationship via the Gemeindeschluessel. Omitting the join produces a Cartesian product (every Gemeinde paired with every Freibad) rather than only the matching Gemeinde–Freibad pairs, which is incorrect and will confuse students about whether a join on gemeindeschluessel is required.
issues.suggested_fix:
Add the join condition between Gemeinde and Schwimmbad in the solution (and, if desired, in the template) so only Freibäder in their respective Gemeinden are returned. For example:

SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name
FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad
WHERE Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'
  AND Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel

This fixes the Cartesian product and matches the problem requirement to list each Gemeinde together with its Freibad(s).
